groups.title: Causes of the First World War

items.s: Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia, Russia backed Serbia, Germany backed Austria-Hungary and France was tied to Russia, so one quarrel pulled in every ally.
Britain feared the new German battleships threatened its navy and trade; Germany thought Britain wanted to keep it weak.
It gave Austria-Hungary an excuse to crush Serbia, which it blamed for stirring up Slavs inside its empire.
Any cause, backed by one reason: for example, the alliances, because they turned a Balkan crisis into a European war.

It picks up oxygen in the lungs and gives up carbon dioxide there too.
Her muscles respire faster, so they need more oxygen and glucose delivered.

groups.title: Causes of the First World War

items.s: An alliance is an agreement to defend each other, such as the Triple Entente of Britain, France and Russia.
Germany's Dreadnoughts challenged the Royal Navy, which Britain needed to protect its empire and food supply.
The assassin, Gavrilo Princip, belonged to a Serb nationalist group, and Austria-Hungary believed Serbia's government backed it.
Germany invaded France through Belgium, and Britain had promised in 1839 to protect Belgian neutrality.
Colonies gave raw materials, markets and prestige, so Britain, France and Germany clashed over land in Africa.
Any cause, backed by one reason: for example, the alliances, because they turned a Balkan crisis into a European war.

groups.title: Causes of the First World War

items.s: Russia mobilised to defend Serbia, so Germany declared war on Russia, then France.
